Package model.users

Class Admin

java.lang.Object
model.users.User
model.users.Employee
model.users.Admin
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Observer
public class Admin extends Employee implements Serializable
Represents a system Administrator. Admins can add, update, and remove any User, and view the system action logs.
